overallFinding.summary: Binance has historical Polish VASP registration and currently reachable Poland-facing web/P2P surfaces, including PLN and Santander Poland. Those facts do not prove current legal/account availability after Poland's MiCA transition ended on 2026-07-01. This run could not independently bind a current Binance MiCA/CASP authorisation from a directly parsed ESMA authorised-CASP row; current authoritative media also reports Binance was still seeking EU authorisation in July and remained unapproved in early August.
overallFinding.recommendation: Keep Binance × Poland at UNDER_REVIEW for legal/account/product availability. Preserve public-surface, KYC and PLN/P2P facts as separate evidence dimensions. Do not publish an Available/eligible MarketProfile, Poland-specific referral/bonus eligibility, or country CTA from this record until primary current MiCA authorisation and product/account eligibility are independently verified.

methodologyNotes: No login, account creation, registration attempt, KYC submission, payment, deposit, withdrawal, trade or referral submission was performed.
Old Polish AML/VASP registration was kept separate from post-2026-07-01 MiCA authorisation.
Technical reachability was kept separate from legal availability and account/product eligibility.

The ESMA MiCA register landing page was verified, but the linked authorised-CASP CSV could not be row-parsed by the available research tooling; no absence claim was inferred from that tooling limitation.
Reuters and Financial Times were used only as authoritative-media corroboration, not as substitutes for primary regulator evidence.

quickAnswerCandidates.answer: Do not label Binance available in Poland from this evidence set. The old Polish virtual-currency register was not a KNF licence, the MiCA transition ended on 1 July 2026, and this run did not independently bind a current Binance CASP authorisation from a directly parsed ESMA register row.
Binance exposes public PLN/P2P and Santander Poland surfaces, but those pages prove technical/public reachability only, not legal authorisation or successful resident onboarding.
Binance's current public guidance requires identity verification for full account functionality and for P2P, but that platform-level KYC rule does not prove Poland-specific onboarding eligibility.
Poland-specific Binance referral or bonus eligibility remains unconfirmed; CBW's globally owner-confirmed commercial link/code does not prove Poland campaign eligibility.
